status: ECON-SIM-4.2 offline experiment — all new values provisional, no game adoption

assumptions.lifeWater: Net make-up water .1–1 L/person/day, 30-day settlement; Earth zero. NASA ~3.8 L crew/day and98% recovery support the low-end order, not a colony prescription. No new water source or reclamation engine.
assumptions.waterCost: Attribute50% of existing .002C/U variable service cost to actual metered intake; sensitivity0/50/100%; no extra input cost or invented free electricity.
assumptions.boost: (1+b) times unassisted4.1 capacity, replacing rather than adding the assisted-H recipe. Report actual ON/OFF benefit separately.
assumptions.maintenance: Existing industry-asset bill uses output-capacity activeFraction; no extra cost discount.
assumptions.hydrogenCustody: Private produced H used before purchases; government reserve H is not automatically sold for new demand.
assumptions.cutFixture: Identical explicit paid preparation on OFF/ON:60000 C ceiling per colony from existing Earth treasury,5500U alloy/200U H existing SCU requests, and two5000U H purchases at ticks0/24 from Earth private stock at a positive quote. No money/material creation; after costs/orders supply may remain constrained.
assumptions.backup: Monthly primary-mode hysteresis remains; within a hydrogen-primary month any H-unfunded processing time uses the existing unassisted conventional recipe. No extra assisted H or cold restart is charged for dispatch backup; formal primary switches alone pay the switch quote. Actual backup output is separately reported.
assumptions.recycling: A recycle-only electrolyzer may be co-located with an existing smelter once real byproduct water exists. It has no natural intake, ice or water imports; same existing electrolyzer costs/output/power. Colonies use their own byproduct water; it is not an automatic release of government stock.
